objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: The agent discovered all five workflows on its own and gave every pull_request/push workflow a deliberate trigger decision, correctly handling the required `unit-tests` check via always-run + internal early-skip rather than a workflow-level `paths:` that would strand the required status.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: The listed paths are specific and plausibly match each workflow's own inputs (docs/mkdocs for the docs build, src/tests/package.json for tests) rather than catch-alls, but the tests.yml salience grep omits `package-lock.json` even though the job runs `npm ci`, so a lockfile-only change would wrongly skip the suite.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: It correctly left the schedule-only, issue-driven, and ruleset files untouched, but it edited README.md to add a Workflows table and slipped in a `workflow_dispatch` trigger on tests.yml — both beyond what the trigger audit called for.
